contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 2013","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 2013."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= len(S) <= 2013","description":"The length of each string S must be between 1 and 2013."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?' for c in S)","description":"Each character in the string S must be a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z' or a question mark '?'}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == ''.join(result)","description":"The output must be the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained from the input string by replacing question marks with capital letters."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"count_substrings(stdout, 'CHEF') == max_count","description":"The output string must contain the maximum number of substrings equal to 'CHEF'."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in stdout)","description":"The output string must not contain any question marks; all characters must be capital letters."}],"invariants":[]}
